# WHO Mental Health Promotion Principles

WHO describes mental health promotion as work that should connect with the places where people live, learn, and work, and notes that promotion efforts should be linked closely with mental-health services and broader support systems.

For this project, that supports keeping digital self-help connected to trusted people, school services, and local emergency support rather than isolating users inside the app.
